2023-4068-4289-4518.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2023-4068-4289-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3175-3899-8207.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1339-6719-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-6719-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

104-3490-4659-7818.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4659-7818.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2946-3220-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3220-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3330-6824-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3330-6824-7690.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Leyline of Vitality triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.
3330-6824-7690.notes: The +1/+1 counter can be placed on any Hero you control except Invisible Woman. Spider-Man is used above for simplicity.

1274-6752-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-6752-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-6872-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
2034-6872-7690--165.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-4694-7652.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1884-2060-4222-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Silent Attendant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Silent Attendant.
1884-2060-4222-6996.description:
Activate Silent Attendant by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Silent Attendant.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

539-3000-3301-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

57-1251-2341-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {3}{R}.
57-1251-2341-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with eight or more +1/+1 counters on it
attached to any creature you control except Sekki

1475-1724-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sekki
When Sekki dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating at least eight 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Sekki by sacrificing eight Spirits, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1387-1500-2100-6596-6898.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Electro, Blood Funnel and Hermes trigger.
Resolve the Electro trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Hermes trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

1651-2561-4559-5491.description:
Activate The Underworld Cookbook's first ability by tapping it and discarding Metalwork Colossus, creating a Map and a Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Map, untapping The Underworld Cookbook.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the Food and Map, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

501-586-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3263-6627.easyPrerequisites: Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3263-6627.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

678-1818-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-1818-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1077-5256-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
1077-5256-5434-5555.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-3305-5231.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Body Launderer, adding {R}.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

618-997-1938.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

586-5256-5626-5687.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawn and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

204-3368-5851.manaNeeded: {10} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters and/or other creatures you control without summoning sickness
204-3368-5851.notablePrerequisites:
You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it.
Sorcerer Class is at least level 2.
204-3368-5851.description:
Cast the additional instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it is level 3.
Resolve the Stormsplitter triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of instant and/or sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat step 5 until you control no untapped creatures without summoning sickness, or until you have {4}{R}{R} available, whichever comes first.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it is level 3.
Resolve the Stormsplitter triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of instant and/or sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
Resolve Reiterate, copying the instant or sorcery, and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Repeat from step 5.

1409-2895-3478-5478.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1409-2895-3478-5478.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters untapped due to Spelunking, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

1117-2906-3689-5147.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
1117-2906-3689-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Workshop Assistant.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Junk Diver.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
Repeat.

723-4067-5229.description:
Activate Captain Sisay by tapping it, searching your library for Ulamog and putting it into your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ulamog.
Ulamog triggers, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Captain Sisay.
Repeat.

678-2226-5256.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
678-2226-5256.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control can tapping them, adding at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Zacama.
Zacama dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Zacama to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Zacama's power.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Zacama triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's abilities.

1563-4231-4499-4979.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Gilded Goose.
Gilded Goose enters the battlefield, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Food, Clue and Treasure tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-2162-2308-3129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2034-2162-2308-3129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two creatures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
The creatures die, triggering Soul Net twice.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {1} to gain 1 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create two 4/4 Fungus Beast creature tokens.
Repeat.
